verdict.rationale: Wave is accounting software, so an agent answering affordability questions from live ledger data via an API is a fair axis. The evidence shows no first-party agent, MCP, or AI-assistant capability. The only API evidence is a probe showing a live GraphQL endpoint that answers one introspection query; no ledger-query documentation could be retrieved, and the marketing pages document no API, MCP, or CLI surface. At most that endpoint is a developer building block, which earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API
